map.→ 打开灌溉用水量估算工具: -> Open the irrigation water demand estimate tool
map.净灌溉量 = 作物需水 ETc − 有效降雨 Pe。汛期降雨集中时，应在每次灌前: Net irrigation = crop water requirement ETc − effective rainfall Pe. When monsoon rainfall is concentrated, deduct recent rainfall before each irrigation to avoid over-irrigation and waterlogging.
map.填写「灌溉水利用系数」。: Fill in "the irrigation water use efficiency".
map.怎么考虑降雨省下的水？: How is the water saved by rainfall taken into account?
map.按灌水定额估算一次灌水总量：V = 面积 × 灌水定额（m³/亩）。: Estimate the volume of one irrigation from the per-mu quota: V = area x irrigation quota (m³/mu).
map.根据灌溉面积、计划灌水深度与渠道利用系数估算毛用水量，支持滴灌喷灌漫灌等不同系数: Estimates the gross water demand from the irrigated area, the planned watering depth and the canal efficiency, supporting different coefficients for drip, sprinkler and flood irrigation, which helps with irrigation quotas and pump scheduling.
map.灌水定额和灌溉定额有什么区别？: What is the difference between the per-event irrigation quota and the seasonal irrigation quota?
map.灌水定额是『一次』灌水的量（m³/亩），灌溉定额是『全生育期』各次灌水定额之和。: The per-event quota is the amount for one irrigation (m³/mu), while the seasonal quota is the sum of all the per-event quotas over the whole growing season. Both are needed when designing the canal system and pump station.

map.种植密度计算器（株距×行距）（农业）: Planting density calculator (in-row spacing x row spacing) (agriculture)
map.结合作物需水量 ETc 与有效降雨，反推净灌溉定额。: Combine the crop water requirement ETc with the effective rainfall to back out the net irrigation quota.
map.：面积 50 亩，灌水定额 40 m³/亩，则本次灌水总量 V = 50 × 4: : with an area of 50 mu and an irrigation quota of 40 m³/mu, the volume for this irrigation is V = 50 x 40 = 2000 m³. With a source pump flow of 50 m³/h, water must be supplied continuously for 40 hours.
